definitions.spearman_logfc: Average-tie rank correlation of adjusted log2(CPM+1) condition coefficients on the shared selected feature universe; higher is better.
definitions.top_k_jaccard: Jaccard overlap of top 50 absolute adjusted effects on the shared selected feature universe; ties broken by gene ID; higher is better.
definitions.distance_correlation: Pearson correlation of strict upper triangles of Euclidean sample distances on log2(CPM+1); full uses all source genes and pocket uses selected genes; higher is better.
definitions.sign_concordance: Fraction of equal coefficient signs for shared genes with absolute full-source effect at least 0.1; pocket zero disagrees with a nonzero full effect; higher is better.
